tooltips.maid_restaurant_business.jiuhu_: Put packed takeout bags inside; the sake fox delivers them through the gap and earnings arrive automatically. Holds up to five orders.
tooltips.maid_restaurant_business.schedu: Set the shop's automation schedule and thresholds. Right-click to configure.
tooltips.maid_restaurant_business.order_: Holds one pending order; the cook takes it when a counter is free. Walk-in orders received by waiters are clipped here too.
tooltips.maid_restaurant_business.health: Not bound, right-click an order machine
